stories.headline: The Download: Silicon Valley’s blind spot and Nvidia’s chip-tracking plan
stories.dek: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why did it get the midterms so wrong? —Aaron Zamost, a tech communications consultant and a former executive at Squar

stories.headline: Synchron Pauses Trials of Its Brain Implant Due to Performance Issues
